# Format properties: Slicers

> **Applies to:** Creators · Developers

Every card and property the Format pane offers for the visuals on this page (Slicer, List slicer, Text slicer, Button slicer), generated from the visual definitions in the code. For how to use the Format pane, see [Format a visual](../../create-reports/format-a-visual.md); for what these visuals do, see [the visual article](../../visuals/slicers.md).

The cards on the **General** tab that every visual shares (title, effects, header icons, tooltips, alt text) are listed once in [General tab](general-tab.md).

| Visual | PBIR type | Visual-tab cards | Properties |
|---|---|---|---|
| Slicer | `slicer` | 16 | 104 |
| List slicer | `listSlicer` | 7 | 24 |
| Text slicer | `textSlicer` | 1 | 18 |
| Button slicer | `advancedSlicerVisual` | 14 | 64 |
